question: Who among the following players created a record by winning the Hopman Cup the greatest number of times as of December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Roger Federer.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roger Federer** created a record by winning the Hopman Cup the greatest number of times as of December 2020.
 
• Switzerland won their third Hopman Cup as Roger Federer and Belinda Bencic beat Germany's Alexander Zverev and Angelique Kerber.
 
• Belinda Bencic and Roger Federer are swiss tennis champions.
 
• It was Federer's second Hopman Cup triumph after a victory in 2001 alongside then-world number one Martina Hingis.
 
• The final was held at the Perth Arena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Hopman Cup is an international eight-team indoor hardcourt tennis tournament that plays mixed-gender teams on a country-by-country basis.
 
• It was held in Perth, Western Australia each year from 1989 to 2019.
 
• It was replaced on the calendar in 2020 by the ATP Cup, a newly created ATP event. 
 
• It is set to return on the calendar in 2023 in a French venue.
